children: PORR LAUNCHES OFFERING OF AN UP TO EUR 150 MILLION HYBRID CONVERTIBLE BOND
BOND WILL BE ISSUED AT PAR WITH A TOTAL NOMINAL AMOUNT OF UP TO EUR 150 MILLION AT A DENOMINATION OF EUR 100,000
FIXED RATE BETWEEN 2.500% AND 3.000% PER ANNUM FROM ISSUE DATE
30 SEPTEMBER 2031 IS THE FIRST RESET DATE
SETTLEMENT OF BOND IS EXPECTED TO TAKE PLACE ON OR AROUND 30 SEPTEMBER 2026
